thinking: Thinking Process: 1. **Analyze the Request:** * **Project:** A deployable static website for "每日视界" (Daily Vision), a national online news outlet. * **Target Audience:** Adults reading news daily (commutes, breaks). * **Language:** Simplified Chinese (all visible text). * **Structure:** * `index.html` (Home page with latest headlines). * Category page (e.g., Business/Tech) with article list. * Article page (full news story). * `about.html` (About page). * *Constraint:* At least 3 pages + index.html (so 4 files total minimum). * **Technical Constraints:** * Return as multiple files using the specific format (`===== FILE: filename =====`). * No external resources (CSS/JS/fonts must be inline or internal). * Relative links only (no `target="_blank"`, no absolute URLs). * Responsive design (desktop ~1440px, works on narrower). * Realistic content (no "Lorem ipsum"). * No AI/Company names in metadata/comments. * No submission functionality for forms. * **Style:** Professional news website look. 2. **Drafting Content & Structure:** * **Brand Name:** 每日视界 (Rì Wèi Shì Jiè). * **Color Scheme:** Professional news colors (Navy blue, white, dark gray, red for accents/urgent news). * **Navigation:** Home, 国内 (Domestic), 国际 (International), 财经 (Business), 科技 (Tech), 关于我们 (About). * **Pages:** 1. `index.html`: Hero section, top headlines, latest news grid. 2. `category.html` (e.g., 财经频道): List of business articles. 3. `article.html`: A detailed view of one specific article. 4. `about.html`: Information about the outlet, contact info. * **Content Ideas (Simplified Chinese):** * *Headline:* 中国经济稳中向好，高质量发展取得显著成效 (China's economy stabilizes, high-quality development achieves results). * *Tech:* 人工智能推动制造业升级 (AI drives manufacturing upgrade). * *Business:* 新能源股票持续攀升 (New energy stocks continue to rise). * *International:* 全球气候峰会达成共识 (Global climate summit reaches consensus). 3. **Design System (CSS):** * Reset CSS. * Flexbox/Grid for layout.
